questions.q: 7. When x² + ax + b is divided by (x - 1) the remainder is 15 when x² + bx + a is divided by (x + 1) the remainder is -1 then the value of a² + b² is:
questions.s:
7.(b) When x² + ax + b is divided by (x - 1) the remainder is 15

Using remainder theorem, we have :

⇒ 1² + a + b = 15

⇒ a + b = 14 ---------- (1)

When x² + bx + a is divided by (x +1) the remainder is -1

Again, Using remainder theorem.we have :

⇒ (-1)² - b + a = -1

⇒ 1 + a - b = -1

⇒ a - b = -2 ---------- (2)

Adding eqn(1) and (2) we have :

⇒ a = 14-22=122 = 6 , b = 14 - 6 = 8

a2 + b2= 62 + 82= 36 + 64 = 100

questions.q:
Which of the following statement is true?

I. 2956+6787 is a prime number.

II. 14661 - 8841 is a prime number.

निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सत्य है?

I. 2956+6787 एक अभाज्य संख्या है|

II. 14661 - 8841 एक अभाज्य संख्या है|
o: Both I and III और II दोनों
Neither I nor IIन तो I और न ही II
questions.s:
I. When an odd number is multiplied by itself multiple times, then solution gives an odd value. So, 2956 and 6787 are odd.

Addition of two odd number always gives an even value. So, 2956+6787 is even and an even number cannot be a prime number.(except 2, which is not possible in this case)

Hence, statement I is wrong.

II. When an even number is multiplied by itself multiple times, then solution gives an even value. So, 14661 and 8841 are even.(except 2, which is not possible in this case)

Addition of two even number always gives an even value. So, 14661 - 8841 is even and an even number cannot be a prime number.

Hence, statement II is wrong.

questions_hin.q_hi: 7. यदि X² + ax + b को जब (x - 1) दवारा भाग किया जाता है तो 15 शेष बचता है  और जब x² + bx + a को (x + 1) दवारा भाग किया जाता है तो -1 शेष बचता है तो a² + b² का मान क्या है:
questions_hin.s_hi:
7.(b) जब x² + ax + b को (x – 1) से विभाजित किया जाता है तो शेषफल 15 होता है

शेष प्रमेय (remainder theorem) का उपयोग करके,:

⇒ 1² + a + b = 15

⇒ a + b = 14 ---------- (1)

जब x² + bx + a को (x + 1) से विभाजित किया जाता है तो शेष -1 होता है

पुनः, शेषफल प्रमेय (remainder theorem) का प्रयोग करने पर,

⇒ (-1)² - b + a = -1

⇒ 1 + a - b = -1

⇒ a - b = -2 ---------- (2)

समीकरण (1) और (2) को जोड़ने पर हमें प्राप्त होता है:

⇒ a = 14-22=122= 6 , b = 14 - 6 = 8

a2 + b2  = 62 + 82 = 36 + 64 = 100

questions_hin.q_hi: 13. वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जिससे 60 और 90 को भाग देने पर क्रमशः 2 और 3 शेषफल बचे।

Which of the following statement is true?

I. 2956+6787 is a prime number.

II. 14661 - 8841 is a prime number.

निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सत्य है?

I. 2956+6787 एक अभाज्य संख्या है|

II. 14661 - 8841 एक अभाज्य संख्या है|
o_hi: Both I and III और II दोनों
Neither I nor IIन तो I और न ही II
questions_hin.s_hi:
I. When an odd number is multiplied by itself multiple times, then solution gives an odd value. So, 2956 and 6787 are odd.

Addition of two odd number always gives an even value. So, 2956+6787 is even and an even number cannot be a prime number.(except 2, which is not possible in this case)

Hence, statement I is wrong.

II. When an even number is multiplied by itself multiple times, then solution gives an even value. So, 14661 and 8841 are even.(except 2, which is not possible in this case)

Addition of two even number always gives an even value. So, 14661 - 8841 is even and an even number cannot be a prime number.

Hence, statement II is wrong.
